text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The Parliament has begun the discussion of amendments on 1997 tax and social security contribution rules.
- Opposition parties said the new, looser tax rules for agricultural small producers, proposed by the government, are still too strict.
- The Customs and Financial Supervision (VPOP) has prepared for Hungary's European Union membership, senior VPOP officials said.
- More than one-third of social security contribution arrears is likely to be lost for the social security funds due to company bankruptcies and liquidations.
- Hungary has not received official request for setting up a joint force with Romania for the escort of humanitarian aid transports to Albania, the Foreign Ministry said.
